plain_english: The trained Quantitative Analyst combines technical signals, risk scores, and position sizing outputs. It uses attention-weighted pooling across volatility, drawdown, VaR/CVaR, contagion, liquidity, and regime risk. The attention weights identify which risk modules most strongly shaped the quantitative output.
